Watch: Keep a close eye on the chip sector for confirmation of this warned weakness. Pay extra attention to your leveraged positions for accelerated decay.

Bottom line: With margin and leveraged ETFs, managing risk in your chip heavy portfolio is paramount, especially with current warnings.
plays: Review SOXL (down 53.92%) and SPAL (down 33.48%) for potential trims; their leveraged nature and deep drawdowns are amplified by margin.
